name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 2.23 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
